title: 821. Binary Trees With Factors

examples.explanation: Trees are the single nodes 2 and 4 plus the tree with root 4 and children 2,2.
Four singletons plus trees rooted at 4 (2,2), at 10 (2,5) and at 10 (5,2).
No product of two entries lands back in the set, so only singletons exist.

hints: Sort the values so every factor pair of a root has already been counted.
For each root, add dp[left] * dp[right] over all factor pairs left*right == root, starting from 1 for the singleton.
